<b>Rule:</b> chunk quality → embedding quality → retrieval quality → answer quality; a bad early stage poisons every later one &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Budget:</b> online path ≈ 1–2 s; indexing is a batch job tuned for quality" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="1880" x="40" y="48" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-3" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 4;strokeColor=#b26a00;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=4;fontStyle=1;fontSize=14;fontColor=#b26a00;" value="A · WHY RAG — decide before designing" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="220" width="1910" x="20" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-4" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 4;strokeColor=#1a56a0;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=4;fontStyle=1;fontSize=14;fontColor=#1a56a0;" value="B · OFFLINE INDEXING — index once, update on change (tune for QUALITY)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="350" width="1910" x="20" y="340" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-5" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 4;strokeColor=#2e7d32;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=4;fontStyle=1;fontSize=14;fontColor=#2e7d32;" value="C · ONLINE QUERY — every request (tune for SPEED + PRECISION)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="1910" x="20" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-6" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 4;strokeColor=#9673a6;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=4;fontStyle=1;fontSize=14;fontColor=#9673a6;" value="D · QUALITY &amp; OPERATIONS — how we know it works and keep it working" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="410" width="1910" x="20" y="1110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-7" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>The four problems with a bare LLM</b><br>1. Knowledge cutoff — never saw yesterday's data<br>2. Hallucination — facts are compressed, not stored<br>3. Retraining is not an update mechanism (cost, days, forgetting)<br>4. Private data was never in the training set" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="430" x="40" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-8" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=1.5;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;verticalAlign=top;" value="<b>DECISION — how do we give the model knowledge?</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="900" x="520" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-9" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>RAG</b> changes what the model SEES — fresh, private facts with citations.<br><b>Chosen for knowledge.</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="280" x="540" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-10" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Fine-tuning</b> changes how the model BEHAVES — tone, format, skill.<br>Optional add-on for style, not for facts." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="280" x="840" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-11" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Long context</b> pastes everything in. value="<b>Decision:</b> table-aware parsing. <i>Why:</i> splitting a fee table by characters detaches the row header from its numbers. <i>Alt:</i> plain-text dump → wrong numbers." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="200" x="310" y="515" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-28" parent="1" value="<b>Decision:</b> structure-aware / recursive split, ~200–800 tokens, 10–20% overlap, tables kept whole. <i>Why:</i> a chunk must be ONE clear idea. <i>Alt:</i> fixed guillotine cuts." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="200" x="580" y="515" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-29" parent="1" value="<b>Decision:</b> domain-fit embedding model, same model for index and query. <i>Why:</i> it caps quality more than the vector DB does. <i>Alt:</i> generic model blind to jargon (TER, ISIN)." value="<b>Decision (index + freshness):</b> ANN (HNSW), not brute force — millisecond lookups at millions of vectors. Metadata tags keep products apart (a LAMF question must not surface a mutual-fund exit-load chunk). BM25 side index catches exact codes. Incremental re-index, not a full rebuild — <i>Why:</i> a stale index gives confident, outdated answers." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="510" x="1400" y="515" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> value="<b>Latency budget (online)</b><br>query embedding + ANN lookup = milliseconds; rerank + LLM = most of the 1–2 s.<br><b>Levers:</b> fewer, better chunks · cache frequent questions · smaller model for easy ones.<br><br><b>Security</b><br>access control at retrieval · PII handled before indexing · log which sources produced each answer.<br><br><b>Fintech rule</b><br>stable facts → vector DB · live numbers → live systems." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="350" width="360" x="1570" y="1150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-90" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=16;fontColor=#222222;fontStyle=1;spacing=4;" value="How to read it — follow the numbers" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="900" x="40" y="1545" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-91" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Flow (①–⑬)</b><br><b>Offline (once, and on change)</b><br>① Documents are parsed, tables kept intact. ② Split into chunks. ③ Each chunk becomes a vector. ④ Stored with metadata + a keyword index. ⑤ A watcher re-indexes only changed documents.<br><br><b>Online (every question)</b><br>⑥ Understand it: stable fact or live number? Rewrite / decompose if complex. ⑦ Filter by product line and permissions. ⑧ Hybrid search (meaning + exact words) → ~50 candidates. ⑨ Rerank to the best 3–8. ⑩ Build the prompt: context is untrusted data with source IDs; live numbers are merged in. ⑪ LLM answers only from the context, citing it. ⑫ Guard checks faithfulness. ⑬ Pass → answer + sources + freshness stamp. Fail → "not confirmed", never a guess.<br><br><b>Example:</b> "LAMF interest rate if I pledge ELSS units?" → filter to LAMF → retrieve policy text + call the live rate API → one grounded, cited answer with a freshness stamp." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="610" x="40" y="1585" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-92" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Architect decisions — say "why A over B"</b><br>1. RAG for knowledge; fine-tune only for style; long context only for small static sets.<br>2. Two pipelines — offline for quality, online for speed — not indexing at query time.<br>3. Table- and structure-aware chunking, not fixed guillotine splits.<br>4. Domain-fit embedding model — it caps quality more than the vector DB.<br>5. ANN index + metadata filters + BM25, not one flat dense-only index.<br>6. Hybrid over dense-only: meaning AND exact codes.<br>7. Rerank ~50 → 5 over stuffing the prompt: precision, cost, "lost in the middle".<br>8. Live numbers through APIs, never from the index.<br>9. Grounded or silent: cite, or say "not found" — never guess in a regulated domain.<br>10. Evaluate retrieval and generation separately; fix retrieval first.<br>11. Add agentic / GraphRAG / Self-RAG only when evaluation demands it." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="610" x="670" y="1585" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kca3TSWwTvor90KrxdZH-93" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Mental model &amp; interview close</b><br><i>Index once → retrieve many times.<br>Chunk well → Embed well → Retrieve well (dense + sparse + hybrid) → Rerank → Ground → Evaluate → Monitor.</i><br><br><b>Trade-offs we accept</b><br>• Hybrid + rerank → more infrastructure and latency<br>• More chunks → better recall but worse precision and higher cost<br>• Guard step → extra latency and cost for safety<br>• Strict "not found" → more refusals, fewer wrong answers<br>• Incremental re-index → a watcher and versioning to run<br><br><b>One-line close:</b> "RAG does not make the model smarter — it changes what the model is allowed to see. Our job is to make that slice small, correct, fresh and permitted."<br><br><b>Honest test:</b> a policy changed this morning — does the system still cite the old version? It must not: versioned chunks + incremental re-index." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="630" x="1300" y="1585" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

3. Retraining is not an update mechanism (cost, days, forgetting)

div.div: Decision: table-aware parsing. Why: splitting a fee table by characters detaches the row header from its numbers. Alt: plain-text dump → wrong numbers.

div.div: Decision: structure-aware / recursive split, ~200–800 tokens, 10–20% overlap, tables kept whole. Why: a chunk must be ONE clear idea. Alt: fixed guillotine cuts.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.div: Decision: domain-fit embedding model, same model for index and query. Why: it caps quality more than the vector DB does. Alt: generic model blind to jargon (TER, ISIN).

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 492px; height: 1px; padding-top: 577px; margin-left: 1390px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Decision (index + freshness): ANN (HNSW), not brute force — millisecond lookups at millions of vectors. Metadata tags keep products apart (a LAMF question must not surface a mutual-fund exit-load chunk). BM25 side index catches exact codes. Incremental re-index, not a full rebuild — Why: a stale index gives confident, outdated answers.

div.div:
Latency budget (online)
query embedding + ANN lookup = milliseconds; rerank + LLM = most of the 1–2 s.
Levers: fewer, better chunks · cache frequent questions · smaller model for easy ones.
Security
access control at retrieval · PII handled before indexing · log which sources produced each answer.
Fintech rule
stable facts → vector DB · live numbers → live systems.

div.div: How to read it — follow the numbers

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 592px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1817px; margin-left: 30px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Flow (①–⑬)
Offline (once, and on change)
① Documents are parsed, tables kept intact. ② Split into chunks. ③ Each chunk becomes a vector. ④ Stored with metadata + a keyword index. ⑤ A watcher re-indexes only changed documents.
Online (every question)
⑥ Understand it: stable fact or live number? Rewrite / decompose if complex. ⑦ Filter by product line and permissions. ⑧ Hybrid search (meaning + exact words) → ~50 candidates. ⑨ Rerank to the best 3–8. ⑩ Build the prompt: context is untrusted data with source IDs; live numbers are merged in. ⑪ LLM answers only from the context, citing it. ⑫ Guard checks faithfulness. ⑬ Pass → answer + sources + freshness stamp. Fail → "not confirmed", never a guess.
Example: "LAMF interest rate if I pledge ELSS units?" → filter to LAMF → retrieve policy text + call the live rate API → one grounded, cited answer with a freshness stamp.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 592px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1817px; margin-left: 660px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Architect decisions — say "why A over B"
1. RAG for knowledge; fine-tune only for style; long context only for small static sets.
2. Two pipelines — offline for quality, online for speed — not indexing at query time.
3. Table- and structure-aware chunking, not fixed guillotine splits.
4. Domain-fit embedding model — it caps quality more than the vector DB.
5. ANN index + metadata filters + BM25, not one flat dense-only index.
6. Hybrid over dense-only: meaning AND exact codes.
7. Rerank ~50 → 5 over stuffing the prompt: precision, cost, "lost in the middle".
8. Live numbers through APIs, never from the index.
9. Grounded or silent: cite, or say "not found" — never guess in a regulated domain.
10. Evaluate retrieval and generation separately; fix retrieval first.
11. Add agentic / GraphRAG / Self-RAG only when evaluation demands it.

div.div:
Mental model & interview close
Index once → retrieve many times.
Chunk well → Embed well → Retrieve well (dense + sparse + hybrid) → Rerank → Ground → Evaluate → Monitor.
Trade-offs we accept
• Hybrid + rerank → more infrastructure and latency
• More chunks → better recall but worse precision and higher cost
• Guard step → extra latency and cost for safety
• Strict "not found" → more refusals, fewer wrong answers
• Incremental re-index → a watcher and versioning to run
One-line close: "RAG does not make the model smarter — it changes what the model is allowed to see. Our job is to make that slice small, correct, fresh and permitted."
Honest test: a policy changed this morning — does the system still cite the old version? It must not: versioned chunks + incremental re-index.
